title: textured sprites
shortDescription: Textured 2D sprites with the FeatureSprites mesh, switchable between flat sprites and billboards
description: A `FeatureSprites` mesh of the `TexturedSpriteKind` preset with room for 256 sprites, built from a capacity and a `colorMap` texture; it creates its `FeatureSpritesGeometry` and `FeatureSpritesMaterial` itself. The sprites come from its `spritePool`, each one gets a frame of the `TileSet` through `setFrame()`, and `sprites.update()` uploads the changed buffers each frame. The button swaps `sprites.placement` between `BillboardPlacement` and `FlatPlacement`: as billboards the sprites turn towards the camera, as sprites they stay flat in their plane.
